newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends up on higher dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends up on higher dollar supply.

text.p: After trading in a wide range, the Bangladesh taka closed higher at 42.5250/5350 to the dollar in interbank trading against a previous 42.5340/5460, dealers said.
The local unit quoted at 42.5350/5450 per dollar in early trade but edged up after banks offered a large volume of dollars.
The interbank call money rates closed down at 4.8 percent to 5.0 percent from the previous 5.25 percent to 5.75 percent in a liquid market.
